title: University Administrator Wins Exemption From Using Workplace AI
excerpt: A University of Kentucky administrator has successfully obtained a religious exemption allowing them to avoid using AI tools at work.
body_html:
A university administrator at the University of Kentucky has successfully secured a religious exemption that excuses them from using artificial intelligence tools in the workplace.

David Durman obtained the exemption, marking an unusual intersection of religious accommodation policies and modern workplace technology adoption.

The decision highlights how traditional employment policies regarding religious beliefs are beginning to intersect with the mandatory implementation of new workplace technologies.
